searchText: RLP really sucks In a lot of important ways And we're trying to get rid of it over time Also, it gives us a cool property that proofs to a certain block are size log(N) rather than N if you have a trusted SSZ root of an ArchiveHeader (which could just be baked into EL/CL for all blocks prior to the merge as that set will never change) I guess we could use a merkle tree (or accumulator) of block headers to achieve that? yeah that is how it is done with the ssz, it is a merkle root
